description: MDB: Table T(ID LONG PK, N DECIMAL(18, 4) via ADO DDL) populated with Null, -12345678901234.5678, -100.25, -1, -0.0001, 0, 0.0001, 1, 123.45, 12345678901234.5678; CREATE INDEX IX_NA ON T(N), CREATE INDEX IX_ND ON T(N DESC), then incremental INSERT (11, -123.45). Keeps all pages before/after DDL, rows, IX_NA, IX_ND, incremental insert, and Close so exact ascending & descending NUMERIC key bytes (ACE corrected vs Jet 4 legacy sign byte) are captured. Verifies ORDER BY N ASC/DESC, table-type index walks on IX_NA & IX_ND, and Seek (=, >=, <=, >, <) on both indexes.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY)
ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN N DECIMAL(18, 4)
INSERT INTO T (ID, N) VALUES (1, Null)
CREATE INDEX IX_ND ON T (N DESC)
SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY N ASC, ID ASC
SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY N DESC, ID ASC
